formula: the + short adj + -est · the most + long adj · one of the + superlative + plural
when_to_use: Say which is number one in a group: short adjectives take 'the -est', longer ones take 'the most'.
when_to_use_ar: للتعبير عن الأعلى في مجموعة: الصفات القصيرة the -est، والطويلة the most.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Learners omit 'the' before superlatives (Arabic marks it differently) and mix '-est' with 'most' ('the most biggest').

examples.en: This is the most beautiful place.
He is one of the best players.

common_errors.explanation: Use either -est OR most, never both.

practice_fill_blank.sentence: He is ___ (good) student in the class.
It was ___ (bad) day of my life.

quick_rule: the + -est (short) / the most (long). Irregulars: the best, the worst.
quick_rule_ar: the + -est للقصيرة / the most للطويلة. والشاذ: the best, the worst.
mnemonic: Number one → THE + -EST or THE MOST.
connect_to_speaking: Describe your favourites: 'The best day of my week is Friday. Cairo is the most crowded city I know.'
